subject: EB stakeholder sprint + sponsor wave plan and MAP for close
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@acmecloud.com>, sales@acmecloud.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EB stakeholder sprint + sponsor wave plan and MAP for close

Lydia / Joel —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, the quickest path to a December close for the pilot is a short EB (executive briefing) sprint that lines up the evaluation milestones with an identified exec sponsor and two weekly syncs for the next three weeks. I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a concise evaluation criteria doc to get us started.

Key asks from Acme: a named exec sponsor (VP+), availability for two 30-minute EB syncs over the next 3 weeks, and a small list of evaluation owners for perf/cost/security.

What I propose:
- Week 1 (Dec 1–4): Align sponsor and finalize MAP items
- Week 2 (Dec 7–11): Run core evals and regen pass; mid-sprint EB sync
- Week 3 (Dec 14–18): Final validation, pricing/contract review, prep EB

I attached: RWD-Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft) and acme-eval-criteria.pdf (short eval checklist). Please point to any missing items and confirm who on your side will act as sponsor and evaluation owner.

Available EB windows (PT): Tue 12/8 11:00–12:00, Wed 12/9 14:00–15:00, Thu 12/10 09:00–10:00. If none fit, propose two alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Manager, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: RWD-Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme-eval-criteria.pdf (PDF)
From: Lydia Park <lydia@acmecloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, sales@acmecloud.com
Cc: Joel Turner <joel.turner@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EB stakeholder sprint + sponsor wave plan and MAP for close

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear plan. Joel and I reviewed the MAP; looks good as a working draft. Quick answers: Joel Turner (CTO) will be our exec sponsor for the pilot — he can escalate decisions if needed. Evaluation owners: myself (functional), Marcus Patel (performance lead, cc'd on internal thread), and our security lead will be added once we finish the internal vetting tomorrow.

We can do Tue 12/8 11:00–11:30 PT for the first EB sync and Wed 12/16 14:00–14:30 PT for the close check. The 12/9 slot conflicts with our board prep.

Please update the MAP with the sponsor and the two agreed EB windows. Also, can you add a short row that captures what success looks like for the speed/cost targets? That will help our procurement and infra owners.

Thanks,
Lydia
Head of Product, Acme Cloud
lydia@acmecloud.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@acmecloud.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EB stakeholder sprint + sponsor wave plan and MAP for close

Lydia / Naomi —

Thanks — I updated the MAP (v1) with the sponsor row and the two EB windows. I also added an initial success criteria cell for speed/cost: target latency P95 <= 120ms and token cost delta <= 0.8x of current baseline (we'll refine after initial eval).

Notes on evaluation cadence: we'll run our standard perf harness against your sample subset (need a 24-hour access window for the dataset). Rishi (that’s me) and Marcus will own the perf runs; Naomi, please work with Lydia to confirm the dataset owner and access.

I attached two small artifacts (see thread attachments in the MAP folder): an eval-run checklist and a short troubleshooting playbook if we hit model-specific regressions.

-Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 10:02 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EB stakeholder sprint + sponsor wave plan and MAP for close

Lydia —

Thanks for confirming Joel as sponsor and the two windows. I updated the shared MAP link with the sponsor name and the success criteria that Rishi proposed. Link is in the related_links. Joel — welcome; quick ask: could you confirm the procurement point-of-contact for the pricing review? That will help us prep the SOW draft and DocuSign route.

We’ll set the EB sync on Tue 12/8 11:00–11:30 PT and send an invite for the mid-sprint check on Wed 12/16 14:00–14:30 PT per Lydia’s note. If anyone needs a different timezone mapping, speak up now.

Next steps (short):
- Naomi: send calendar invites + attach MAP v1 and eval checklist (TODAY)
- Lydia: confirm dataset owner and procurement contact (by Mon 12/6)
- Rishi/Marcus: prepare perf harness and smoke-run plan (by 12/7)

Thanks all — let’s keep the thread light (quick updates) and use the shared Drive for edits.

Best,
Naomi

Attachment: RWD-Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (updated with sponsor and timings)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EB stakeholder sprint + sponsor wave plan and MAP for close

Quick confirmation: Marcus here — I’ll lead the perf runs and will be on both EB syncs. Rishi and I plan a short smoke run on 12/7 (isolated namespace) and a full harness run the night of 12/8 once we have the sample set.

I added a single-line fallback: if the smoke run shows >10% regression on any key eval, we’ll pause the wider harness and schedule an afternoon triage with Acme and our runtime team (we can aim for same-day triage). That is reflected in the MAP under risk mitigation.

See you on Tue 12/8 at 11:00 PT.

Marcus Lin
Principal Performance Engineer
Redwood Inference
